!!! warning TS377153: `Effect.mapError` + `Effect.map` transform the success and failure channels one step at a time; `Effect.mapBoth` expresses both transformations in a single step. effect(mapMapErrorToMapBoth)
    
    // MUST NOT TRIGGER: a spread argument is not a single callback
    export const spreadArgument = source.pipe(Effect.map(...callbacks), Effect.mapError((e) => e.length))
